{{Infobox map |name=Nuke |year=2022 |image=nuke_optimus.png |creator=[[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[link]] |gametype=4on4 |size=Large |download=https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/621/nuke/ }} Nuke (nuke.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created in 2023 by [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[link]]. [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[nano]] did the lights on the map.
The original Counter-Strike map is one of five Counter-Strike maps that the mappers of [[The Wizard's Manse]] are creating/converting. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring=1 |pent=1 |hp100=3 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=1 |lg=2 |rl=1 |gl=1 |sng=2 |ng= |ssg=2 }} ==Gallery== nuke_cpu.png nuke_lg.png nuke_locker.png nuke_pent2.png nuke_pent3.png nuke_quad3.png nuke_ra2.png nuke_rl2.png nuke_sub-lvl.png nuke_water.png ==Layout== The quakeworld version of Nuke is close to a 1:1 scale from the original with some obvious changes to the outside area (smaller). The inside areas are pretty much 1:1. This map also gives a new and neat feature with some see-through-glasses. Nuke got an upper level wich contains of an outside area and inside areas. The lower level is only inside; the two access points to the lower level you access from each side, or you spawn there.

==Strategy & Tactics== Items are spread out and RA sits on a neat place in the lower level. RL and LG are on the upper level and far from each other. There is also a LG at the lower level. To get ammo and armors you need to move. Camping items might not be favorable as the choke points are rare and the spawns are spread out. ===Download=== You can download the map [https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/621/nuke/ HERE]
